purpose: Stage 2 drug-perturbation model candidate (deployed): PerturbNet conditional INN + ChemicalVAE

sources.method: git clone <url> source/ && git -C source checkout <commit> && rm -rf source/.git
HF download of selected files through the hf-mirror.com mirror (the assets are not author-released)
sources.note: 7 files / 2,190,893,047 B: LINCS + sci-Plex cINN checkpoints (664 MB each), sci-Plex scVI cell-VAE (13 MB), LINCS TF1 cell-VAE (17 MB), ZINC ChemicalVAE (16 MB), example LINCS (30,568 x 978) and sci-Plex (31,200 x 5,087) h5ads. Per-file sizes/SHA256 were recorded in the deleted old `ASSETS.md` (still present under `source/ASSETS.md`).

notes: Deployed model; the 5,087-gene sci-Plex checkpoint is the Stage 2-relevant one. Absorbed from the deleted VALIDATION.md: released LINCS + sci-Plex checkpoints load into the in-repo architecture with all flow/ChemicalVAE keys matched; sci-Plex cINN conditioning_dim=200 = 196 ChemicalVAE dims + 3 cell-type one-hots + 1 raw numeric dose, so arbitrary doses can be supplied at inference; full inference needs the authors' Python 3.7 + TensorFlow 1.15 pin (or the 0.0.3b1 py3.10 branch). The assets came through the hf-mirror, per the deleted download/manual.md intro.
